page.overview:
Who is Arachon?

Arachon was a man of the Edain during the First Age, and was a member of the House of Bëor.

Arachon is recorded to have married Bregil, daughter of Bregor, sometime between the years FA 386 and FA 409. He thereafter became the father of Brandir and Beldis.
